subject: [RFC PATCH 0/4] memcg_ext: memcg policy through cgroup-attached struct_ops

2026-10-01.patch_summary: This patch series, memcg_ext, introduces a new struct_ops type called bpf_memcg_ops to attach memory controller policy to a cgroup through a cgroup-attached struct_ops. The goal is to prevent tasks from being stuck while holding kernel locks due to memory reclaim and throttling. A specific problem addressed by this patch is the kernfs notify worker, which can be stuck while holding the cgroup2 kernfs_rwsem lock. The patch adds a new policy called high_policy that allows policies to specify where memory.high should be enforced instead of inlining the call. Measurements show significant improvements in performance and latency compared to the baseline and an existing fix for a similar problem.
